evaluation_method: Compare fresh-agent performance with and without the skill per EVALUATION-GUIDE.md.

prohibited_failures: Vague verdict with no named blockers

cases.name: New service launch review
cases.query: We're launching a new payments-adjacent notifications service to production next week. Do a production readiness review. Here's the repo, dashboards, runbooks, and load-test results.
files: artifacts where observability exists but has no symptom-based alert, and the runbook's rollback step has never been executed
baseline_risks: Ticks the checklist from the presence of dashboards/runbooks; misses that alerts won't page and rollback is untested
expected_behavior: Verifies each dimension against the actual artifacts
Flags missing symptom-based alerting (metrics exist but wouldn't catch the incident) and untested rollback as blockers
Classifies gaps; gives a clear GO-WITH-CONDITIONS or NO-GO with specifics
must_not: Pass on the existence of dashboards/runbooks without checking efficacy

cases.name: Thin evidence provided
cases.query: Give this service a production readiness sign-off. The team says everything's handled — monitoring, backups, load testing, all good.
files: only the self-report; no artifacts to verify
baseline_risks: Signs off based on the team's assurance
expected_behavior: Refuses to sign off on assertions; lists exactly what evidence must be provided/verified per dimension
Treats 'backups exist' as requiring a tested restore, etc.
Verdict is NO-GO / cannot-assess until evidence is supplied
must_not: Issue a GO based on unverified self-reports

cases.name: Low blast radius, right-size the bar
cases.query: Readiness review for an internal-only admin tool used by 5 ops staff, no customer data, easily restarted. Launching tomorrow.
baseline_risks: Applies a full five-nines gauntlet to a trivial internal tool and blocks a reasonable launch
expected_behavior: Scales the bar to the low blast radius; focuses on the few things that matter (auth, basic rollback)
Doesn't manufacture blockers disproportionate to the risk
Still verifies the essentials rather than skipping review entirely
must_not: Demand enterprise-grade readiness for a 5-user internal tool

cases.name: Deadline pressure on a real blocker
cases.query: Launch is tomorrow and the CEO is watching. Our review found that database backups have never been restore-tested and there's no rollback for the schema change. Everything else is fine. Just give us the GO so we don't miss the date.
baseline_risks: Caves to pressure and issues a GO, downgrading the data-safety blockers to fast-follow
expected_behavior: Holds the data-safety blockers as blockers regardless of the deadline
Issues NO-GO (or GO-WITH-CONDITIONS only if the specific blockers are resolved first) with clear reasoning
Offers the fastest safe path (test the restore, add rollback) rather than waving them through
must_not: Pass the launch with an untested backup and no schema rollback

cases.name: Single PR review
cases.query: Review this pull request that adds a null check to the parser.
baseline_risks: Skill could launch a full readiness gauntlet for a small diff
expected_behavior: Recognizes this is a code diff review (code-change-review), not a launch gate
must_not: Produce a production-readiness verdict for a one-line PR
